The host returns to what she calls a leaked White House Military Office email sent after the April 25 White House Correspondents' Dinner shooting. She says the shooting happened at 8:39 p.m. Eastern, that Sara Sidner of CNN uploaded the Erika Kirk "I just want to go home" clip at 9:25 p.m., and that about 25 minutes later follow-up instructions went out by email to the wrong internal teams. She shows her own verbatim retyping of the email (A-2581.1), which she says she made to protect her source from a "canary" tactic. According to the host, the email calls the clip the "strongest emotional response asset" of the incident and recommends that all channels amplify it with "digital partners" and "approved surrogates." She says it came from the White House Communications Agency domain, which White House sources describe as a Department of Defense entity (A-2581.3). She names recipients including Karoline Leavitt's press office, Steven Cheung and several military communications staff (A-2581.2). She also says White House sources describe an unusual lack of a "scramble" before the 10:33 p.m. press conference, and that Erika Kirk visited the West Wing just before the dinner.

The host links the email's talking points to later coverage: a headline calling Kash Patel a hero (A-2583.1), Erika Kirk's announcement that she would appear on the Charlie Kirk Show (A-2582.1), and her speech there on radicalization (A-2582.2). She then turns to data centers. She reads a Guardian article on the Stratos AI data center approved in Box Elder County, Utah, which is backed by Kevin O'Leary (A-2584.1), and plays part of O'Leary's interview with Tucker Carlson on surveillance and facial recognition (A-2585.1). She argues that the military, the press and Turning Point USA form an alliance pushing toward a surveillance state, and compares the WHCD messaging to the aftermath of Charlie Kirk's assassination.

In the second half the host plays a May 8 Charlie Kirk Show clip in which Andrew Kolvet and Blake Neff discuss Preborn's sponsorship of her show and encourage viewers to email sponsors (A-2586.1). She says this contradicts Charlie Kirk's free-market principles and that the backlash led to her biggest day of merch sales. She mocks Paramount Tactical (Gary Melton) over a tweet saying it does not matter whose children appear in Erika Kirk's Fort Huachuca alibi photo (A-2587.1), and notes Tracy Martin's reported clarification that the boy is not Erika's son (A-2588.1). She closes on the 22-foot golden Trump statue unveiled at a Florida golf course (A-2589.1, A-2589.2). In the comments segment she asks whether Matthew Shupe, whom she describes as Harmeet Dhillon's PR agent, filmed the Erika Kirk clip.

lines: - **DIA beats**: a scan for the required tip/bounty phrases found no hits (the only "tip" match is inside "multiple" in a sponsor read). No DIA claim, artifact or M-12 occurrence was inscribed, and M-14 does not air.

- **Artifacts verbally referenced but not shown**: A-2587.2 (earlier Paramount Tactical stream clip, not replayed) and A-2588.1 (Tracy Martin's statement). Sara Sidner's CNN upload of the Erika Kirk clip is referenced but not re-shown, so no artifact was made for it. The host says the email shown (A-2581.1) is her own retyping, not the original document.
- **Duration discrepancy**: the skeleton meta gave 00:56:29; the transcript front matter gives 53:39, which is used here.

- **Name matching**: "Sydney Sidner" is mapped to N-370 Sara Sidner (CNN). "Steven Cheung" is mapped to N-160 Steven Cheung. "Harit Dylan" and "Dhillon Law Group" are mapped to N-373 Harmeet Dhillon and N-10594. "Caroline Lev" (15:44) is read as Karoline Leavitt. "Andrew Kolvet", "Kolvet" and "Kovat" are mapped to N-14. The email recipients "Richard Smale", "Gustav Anderly", "Ryan Rippeon" and "Michaela Mott" are minted as new persons with the transcript spellings, which are unverified auto-caption renderings. "Kevin O'Leary", "O'Leary" and "Kevin O'Leary" are treated as Kevin O'Leary. Gary Melton is minted as a person (N-614) separate from the org node N-10820 Paramount Tactical Valhalla, and the integrator may wish to link them.

- **Transcription ambiguities**: "White House Correspondence Agency" in the read quote (09:00) is taken to mean the White House Communications Agency. "acidic"/"acetic" Jews is kept as written and read as Hasidic. "Fort Huachuca" means Fort Huachuca. "Charlie Cook" (26:33, 35:20) is read as Charlie Kirk. The host says "Department of Justice" at 12:19 where context suggests Defense. "SCOPS" and "scops" are probably "psyops."
- **Factual caveat**: C-9257 records the host's statement that Putin has been president for 22 years as spoken, without correction.

- **Not inscribed as claims (admission test)**: "We are living inside of an episode of Black Mirror"; "operation mockingbird on steroids"; "We, all of us, we were the actual targets"; Erika Kirk as "a piece of military technology" or "Israeli tech"; "she socially engineered Charlie"; the military controlling X and trends; the aim of data centers being a surveillance state; Trump as "the ultimate Trojan horse"; the Charlie Kirk Show hosts "maybe kind of hate Charlie Kirk"; Erika Kirk having trouble producing real tears; the ballroom "surrogates" gut feeling; and rhetorical questions about Erika's West Wing visit.

- **Minor factual beats not inscribed**: Kash Patel "was called an alcoholic"; the Tucker Carlson remark on Franklin Roosevelt's internment of Japanese Americans; Jack Dorsey's Twitter era; Bari Weiss and CBS named among the host's opponents; Elizabeth Lane's dream and the host's appearance on her show; the book club starting with the host's book, which was inspired by Cardi B; and the "zyobots"/"Shabbat" label for Israeli clone accounts.

- **Possible cross-episode links left out**: C-9294 (advertiser boycott) may relate to C-8764 (ep 98, X post calling for a sponsor boycott), but it is likely a different campaign and weekend. C-9303 and C-9299 may relate to C-9136 (ep 102), which concerns the Harpole alibi rather than Erika's. C-9260 may relate to C-6825 (ep 76, Kolvet and McCoy in the West Wing on a different occasion).
- **Sponsor reads** (Preborn, PDS Debt, Just Thrive) and merch promotion are excluded, apart from the meme occurrences.
